vectors.description: Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=1, level 30 (-30 dBov). LOC-00 2.3.3.1 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 30 (-30 dBov). LOC-00 2.3.3.1 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 127 (-127 dBov). LOC-00 2.3.3.1 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=1, level 127 (-127 dBov). LOC-00 2.3.3.1 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.

Audio Level: the low 8 bits are the RFC 6464 Section 3 octet: V=0, level 0 (0 dBov). LOC-00 2.3.3.1 defines the value as the audio level and a voice activity indicator; with no vad attribute RFC 6464 Section 4 defaults to vad=on, so V is voice activity.
Audio Level: 383 fits the 1-2 bytes LOC-00 2.3.3.1 states, but only the least significant 8 bits are defined; bits above them are not, so the value is left uninterpreted.
Audio Level: 16384 needs more than 2 bytes as an RFC 9000 varint, beyond the 1-2 bytes LOC-00 2.3.3.1 states.
